def main():
    dna = input().strip()
    result = 0
    run_length = 1
    previous = dna[0]
    i = 1

    while i < len(dna):
        current = dna[i]
        if current != previous:
            previous = current
            i += 1
            continue

        run_length += 1
        is_last = (i == len(dna) - 1)
        is_boundary = is_last or (not is_last and dna[i + 1] != previous)

        if is_boundary and run_length % 2 == 0:
            result += 1
            run_length = 1
        i += 1

    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
